newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Venezuela's Cisneros completes Argentine TV buy.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Cisneros completes Argentine TV buy.

text.p: The Cisneros Television Group said Wednesday it had completed the acquisition of Imagen Satelital SA, Argentina's top cable television programmer, for $114 million.
The deal included $9 million in assumed debt, Cisneros, part of the Caracas-based Cisneros Group of Companies, said.

"The acquisition of Imagen Satelital proves, once more, the Cisneros Group's commitment to becoming the leading Spanish content provider, not only in Latin America, but in Spanish-speaking markets around the world," Cisneros Group Chairman Gustavo Cisneros said in a press release.

Affiliates of the Cisneros Group, which had revenues of $3.2 billion in 1996, include Venevision, the largest producer of Spanish language programming in South America, and Venevision International, which distributes programming.

Cisneros interests include a stake in Galaxy Latin America which delivers Hughes Electronic Corp's satellite service DIRECTV to Latin America, as well as significant holdings in U.S. Spanish-language network Univision, Chilevision, and CCN of Trinidad and Tobago.
